name: pq-verifiable-archive
description: Post-quantum document anchoring for AI agents. Anchor a SHA-256 hash to Algorand mainnet and get a proof bundle signed with ML-DSA-65 (NIST FIPS-204). Verify it later against a pinned issuer with an open-source verifier.

tools.name: anchor_document
tools.description: Anchor a SHA-256 document hash to Algorand mainnet and return a proof bundle signed with ML-DSA-65. Costs a network fee per call and is rate-limited per day. Signers passed in are recorded as requester-asserted (unverified).

parameters.hash: 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256 hash of the document
parameters.envelope_id: (optional) identifier for the document or envelope
parameters.signers: (optional) array of {name, email, signedAt}; stored as requester-asserted, not verified

tools.name: verify_bundle
tools.description: Verify a proof bundle against the configured trusted issuer: ML-DSA-65 signature and issuer key, document hash (if provided), Merkle inclusion, and the Algorand anchor txn (sender, round, note). Also reports, informationally, whether an indexer lists a covering state-proof txn (the Falcon-512 proof itself is not verified).

parameters.bundle: JSON proof bundle returned by anchor_document
parameters.pdf_base64: (optional) base64-encoded PDF to verify document hash

env.ALGORAND_MNEMONIC: 25-word Algorand mnemonic for the issuer wallet
env.PQVA_MLDSA_PUBLIC_KEY: hex-encoded ML-DSA-65 public key (from npm run register-key)
env.PQVA_KEY_REGISTRATION_TXN_ID: Algorand txn ID from npm run register-key
env.PQVA_TRUSTED_ISSUER_ADDRESS: (optional) issuer address verify_bundle trusts; defaults to the hosted service
env.PQVA_TRUSTED_KEY_REG_TXN_ID: (optional) that issuer's key registration txn ID

hostedApi.payment: x402 — $0.01 USDC per anchor on Algorand mainnet
